title: Liquidity bot
description: 1:1 Grafana rendering of the liquidity bot's own dashboard, fed by the exporter sidecar on the VM. Five linked boards mimic the SPA's tabs — use the Dashboard/Orders/PnL/Performance/Logs links above (they carry theme=light so the suite matches the SPA's look). Refresh is 1m polling, not WebSocket-live. On a relative range (the default now-24h) the header and the inventory show the live state, the last 5 minutes, and trades and transfers show the last 30 days. An absolute range shows that range's data in every panel. Open it with &autofitpanels (the Dashboard tab link does) to fill the window height like the SPA. Full history and drilldowns: the IAP dashboard at https://liquidity.t0trade.com (production), or gcloud compute start-iap-tunnel <vm> 8080 --local-host-port=localhost:8080 --zone europe-west3-b --project $env (VM name = project id)

list.name: env
list.label: Environment
list.description: GCP project id — both the Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging queries take it directly.

panels.description: The SPA header's connection light: is the bot process up and answering /health? '—' means the exporter itself is not reporting.

Deployed commit, from /health, cut to 7 characters like the SPA header. The stackdriver plugin runs a range query even for an instant target, so over the dashboard's 24h the previous commit is a second series and its name drew over this one. PromQL also keeps a stopped series for its 5m lookback, so topk on the sample timestamp keeps only the commit with the newest sample, over a 1m window.
The SPA settings bar's Broker pill.
Equity rebalance target. The SPA pill also shows the band: target +/- liq_settings_equity_deviation.
USDC rebalance target. The SPA pill also shows the band: target +/- liq_settings_usdc_deviation.

panels.title: Inventory
panels.description: The SPA's USDC row: Raindex + Alpaca Total + Inflight = Total; Ratio = Raindex/(Raindex+Alpaca Total); Δ = deviation from the target ratio in band widths, colored outside +/-1, where the SPA colors its bar.

promQLQuery.expr: sum by (row, col) (label_replace(label_replace(liq_usdc_onchain_available{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "row", "USDC", "", ""), "col", "Raindex", "", "")) or sum by (row, col) (label_replace(label_replace(liq_usdc_inflight_total{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "row", "USDC", "", ""), "col", "Inflight", "", "")) or sum by (row, col) (label_replace(label_replace(liq_usdc_alpaca_total{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "row", "USDC", "", ""), "col", "Alpaca Total", "", "")) or sum by (row, col) (label_replace(label_replace(liq_usdc_total{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "row", "USDC", "", ""), "col", "Total", "", "")) or sum by (row, col) (label_replace(label_replace(liq_usdc_ratio{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "row", "USDC", "", ""), "col", "Ratio", "", "")) or sum by (row, col) (label_replace(label_replace(liq_usdc_ratio_deviation{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"} and liq_usdc_total{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"} > 0, "row", "USDC", "", ""), "col", "Δ", "", ""))

panels.title: Alpaca
panels.description: Rebalanceable = max(0, withdrawable − reserve). Counter-tradeable deliberately equals Alpaca Total (reserve NOT subtracted, same as the SPA).

promQLQuery.expr: sum by (row, col) (label_replace(label_replace(liq_usdc_alpaca_usdc{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "row", "USDC", "", ""), "col", "USDC", "", "")) or sum by (row, col) (label_replace(label_replace(liq_usdc_rebalanceable{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "row", "USDC", "", ""), "col", "Rebalanceable", "", "")) or sum by (row, col) (label_replace(label_replace(liq_usdc_alpaca_total{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "row", "USDC", "", ""), "col", "Counter-tradeable", "", ""))

panels.title: Wallets
panels.description: USDC seen in the bot's Ethereum and Base wallets: sanity checks, not part of Total.

promQLQuery.expr: sum by (row, col) (label_replace(label_replace(liq_usdc_inflight_ethereum_wallet{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "row", "USDC", "", ""), "col", "Eth", "", "")) or sum by (row, col) (label_replace(label_replace(liq_usdc_inflight_base_wallet{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "row", "USDC", "", ""), "col", "Base", "", ""))

panels.description: The SPA inventory equity table: CT / Rebal / Ext status lights from settings; Raindex / Inflight / Alpaca / Total share balances; Ratio = onchain/(onchain+offchain); Δ = deviation from the target ratio in band widths, colored outside +/-1; Exposure = net × last price. Unwrapped/Wrapped are wallet-observed and not part of Total. Sorted CT-first (desc) so counter-tradeable assets float to the top, like the SPA.

promQLQuery.expr: sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_asset_counter_trading{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "col", "CT", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_asset_rebalancing{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "col", "Rebal", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_asset_extended_hours{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "col", "Ext", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_equity_onchain_available{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "col", "Raindex", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_equity_inflight_total{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "col", "Inflight", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_equity_offchain_available{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "col", "Alpaca", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_equity_total{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "col", "Total", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_equity_ratio{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "col", "Ratio", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_equity_ratio_deviation{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"} and liq_equity_total{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"} > 0, "col", "Δ", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_equity_exposure_usd{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"} or (liq_equity_total{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"} * NaN), "col", "Exposure", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_equity_unwrapped{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "col", "Unwrapped", "", "")) or sum by (symbol, col) (label_replace(liq_equity_wrapped{job="t0-liquidity-exporter"}, "col", "Wrapped", "", ""))

panels.title: Trade History
panels.description: Direct Raindex fills, fills routed through supported adapters such as Bebop, and the corresponding Alpaca hedge trades placed to offset exposure. One row per trade at its latest status. Built from the newest 500 status entries, so a busy period can push older rows out of the 30-day window.

panels.title: Cross-venue Transfers
panels.description: Asset movements between venues to rebalance inventory: equity mints (Alpaca to onchain), redemptions (onchain to Alpaca), and USDC bridges (Base/Ethereum via CCTP). One row per transfer at its latest status. A USDC bridge can show the previous status for a while: the exporter stamps each status with the transfer's updatedAt, which is not always later than the one before (bridging starts from initiated_at). Built from the newest 500 status entries, so a busy period can push older rows out of the 30-day window.
